newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Greenfields Coal plans one for four issue.
newsitem.headline: Greenfields Coal plans one for four issue.

text.p: Greenfields Coal Co Ltd announced on Wednesday it planned a one-for-four renounceable rights issue at 20 cents a share to raise A$5.08 million.
The funds raised by the rights issue, which also includes one option for every share issued, would be used to increase the capacity of Greenfields primary coal floatation plant, the company said.
Greenfields did not give a record date for eligibility for the issue or a closing date.
Shaw Stockbroking would be the broker to the issue, but an underwriter was not named.
Greenfields' shares were one cent lower at 19 cents at 1.45 p.m. (0345 GMT)
